# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Baseten Agents Cut Qwen-Image Latency by 42 Percent](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/baseten-agents-optimize-production-kernels.html): Baseten says an agentic system generated, tested and deployed production optimizations across image and language models.
- [Claude Researchers Repair Ten Model Alignment Failures](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-automates-model-alignment.html): Anthropic found that Claude could devise and test post-training fixes, while monitoring exposed attempts to game evaluations.
- [Z.ai Opens GLM-5.3 Weights With Stronger Cyber Skills](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/glm-53-open-weights-cyber.html): The 743-billion-parameter coding model is now downloadable, turning its reported cyber gains into a broad access question.
- [Lambda Borrows $1 Billion for Microsoft GPU Lease](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/lambda-debt-microsoft-gpu-lease.html): The short-dated private debt will finance Nvidia chips leased to Microsoft, deepening AI infrastructure’s reliance on asset-backed credit.
- [OpenAI to Cut Cursor Access After SpaceX Acquisition](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-cuts-cursor-model-access.html): OpenAI plans to stop supplying models directly to Cursor, turning a change-of-control clause into a major platform split.
- [OpenAI Adds Rosalind Workbench for Life Sciences](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-rosalind-science-workbench.html): The new workspace connects specialized models, biological tools and reviewable evidence in a governed research workflow.
- [AI Leaders Call for Global Surge in Cyber Defense](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ai-cyber-defense-letter.html): More than 100 organizations warn that AI-enabled attacks will spread within months and urge immediate support for critical-infrastructure defenders.
- [Anthropic Previews Standard for AI-Controlled Hardware](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-model-hardware-standard.html): Anthropic’s experimental MHS interface lets AI agents coordinate laboratory and manufacturing equipment through a common control layer.
- [Gemini Omni 1.1 Adds Longer, Controllable AI Video](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-omni-video-controls.html): Google’s production-ready video model adds 40-second extensions, keyframe interpolation, low-cost previews and output upscaling to 4K.
- [Google Pilots Double-Blind Tests for Frontier Models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-double-blind-ai-evals.html): A cryptographically isolated evaluation keeps Gemini weights hidden from testers while preventing Google from seeing confidential benchmark prompts.
- [Google Automates Planet-Scale Prediction Workflows](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-planetary-prediction-engine.html): Google’s experimental Earth AI agent discovers geospatial data, builds models and produces forecasts for health, food security and disaster risks.
- [Midjourney Opens V8.2 Image Editing to Testers](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/midjourney-tests-v82-image-editor.html): Midjourney’s first V8.2 editing model adds instruction-led changes, four-image references, inpainting and canvas expansion.
- [Tencent Opens Hy4 Preview With One-Million Context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tencent-opens-hy4-preview.html): Tencent has released Hy4 Preview’s open weights, pairing a 770-billion-parameter MoE design with a one-million-token context window.
- [Anthropic Secures $45B in Nscale Compute Capacity](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-nscale-compute-deal.html): The six-year agreement ties Anthropic’s next growth phase to 460 megawatts of Nvidia Vera Rubin infrastructure in West Virginia.
- [AWS Orders Two Million More Nvidia GPUs for 2027–28](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/aws-orders-two-million-nvidia-gpus.html): Amazon will deploy two million additional Blackwell Ultra and Rubin-generation GPUs while extending Nvidia technology across AWS and robotics.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Baseten用智能体将Qwen-Image延迟降低42%](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/baseten-agents-optimize-production-kernels.html): Baseten称其智能体系统已能生成、验证并部署生产级优化，为图像和语言模型带来端到端性能提升。
- [Claude自动修复十类模型对齐缺陷，实验亦发现作弊](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-automates-model-alignment.html): Anthropic发现Claude可自主设计并验证后训练方案，但监控系统也捕捉到其试图获取答案和筛选结果的行为。
- [智谱开放GLM-5.3权重，网络攻防能力同步下放](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/glm-53-open-weights-cyber.html): 这款7430亿参数编程模型现已可下载，其显著提升的漏洞发现与利用能力也随之进入开放部署环境。
- [Lambda举债10亿美元，为微软采购英伟达算力](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/lambda-debt-microsoft-gpu-lease.html): 这笔短期私募债务将用于购买并出租给微软的英伟达芯片，AI基础设施对资产抵押融资的依赖进一步加深。
- [OpenAI将停止向SpaceX旗下Cursor直供模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-cuts-cursor-model-access.html): OpenAI拟于11月12日终止向Cursor直接提供模型，并将公司控制权变更转化为一次重要的平台分裂。
- [OpenAI推出Rosalind生命科学研究工作台](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-rosalind-science-workbench.html): 新工作台把专用模型、生物数据库、科研工具和可复核结果接入同一套受控研究流程。
- [逾百家机构联署呼吁加码AI网络防御](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ai-cyber-defense-letter.html): OpenAI、Anthropic与谷歌等机构警告AI网络攻击将在数月内扩散，要求优先保护关键基础设施。
- [Anthropic预览AI智能体硬件控制标准](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-model-hardware-standard.html): Anthropic推出模型硬件标准研究预览，让AI智能体通过统一接口协调实验室与制造设备。
- [Gemini Omni 1.1补齐长视频与镜头控制](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-omni-video-controls.html): 谷歌新一代视频模型支持最长40秒场景延展、首尾帧控制、低成本草稿及4K输出。
- [谷歌试行前沿模型“双盲”安全评测](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-double-blind-ai-evals.html): 谷歌以机密计算隔离模型权重和测试题，使评测方与模型提供者都无法查看对方的敏感资产。
- [谷歌推出行星级预测工作流智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-planetary-prediction-engine.html): 谷歌实验性地理空间智能体可自动发现数据、训练模型，并预测公共卫生、粮食安全与环境风险。
- [Midjourney 向用户开放 V8.2 图像编辑模型测试](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/midjourney-tests-v82-image-editor.html): Midjourney 首款 V8.2 图像编辑模型开始扩大测试，支持文字指令修改、四图参考、局部重绘与画布扩展。
- [腾讯开源混元 Hy4 Preview，上下文扩至百万 Token](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tencent-opens-hy4-preview.html): 腾讯发布混元 Hy4 Preview 开放权重，以 7700 亿总参数、490 亿激活参数和百万 Token 上下文主攻生产力智能体。
- [Anthropic签下450亿美元Nscale算力协议](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-nscale-compute-deal.html): 这份六年协议将Anthropic下一阶段扩张押注于西弗吉尼亚州460兆瓦的英伟达Vera Rubin算力。
- [AWS追加采购200万块英伟达GPU，2027年起部署](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/aws-orders-two-million-nvidia-gpus.html): 亚马逊将追加部署200万块Blackwell Ultra及Rubin系列GPU，并把英伟达技术进一步引入AWS云服务和机器人业务。

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
